# @passport

> Handle (user ID) management and authentication assistant for the atproto ecosystem.

## Summary

@passport allows users to register their atproto handles once and use them across multiple supported applications. It provides a seamless login experience and assists with handle input on unsupported sites via a browser extension.

## Core Features

- **Handle Management**: Register and manage multiple atproto handles.
- **Authentication Assist**: One-tap login for integrated atproto applications.
- **Browser Extension**: Auto-fill handles on any atproto-related website.
- **Device Sync**: Share registered handles across multiple devices using QR codes.
- **Developer Portal**: Verify domain ownership to remove security warnings.

## Key Links

- [About](https://atpassport.net/en/about) - Detailed information and FAQ.
- [Developer Portal](https://atpassport.net/en/developers) - Domain verification and API docs.
- [Directory](https://atpassport.net/en/directory) - List of verified domains.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/usounds/atpassport) - Source code and client libraries.
- [NPM (@atpassport/client)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@atpassport/client) - Client library for developers.
